            <h2 class="font-normal uppercase leading-tight tracking-normal text-[#1a1a1a]" style="font-family:var(--title-font,'Artographie'),sans-serif;font-size:var(--title-size,30px);">
                Where Nature Inspires<br>a New Rhythm<br>of Living            </h2>
                                    <div class="flex flex-col gap-4">
                                <p class="font-sans font-light text-[#3a3a3a] [&_strong]:font-semibold [&_strong]:text-[#1a1a1a]" style="font-size:15px;line-height:var(--desc-leading,1.75rem);">
                    On the shores where the sea, the river, and the enchanting nature of Ceará's coastline meet, lies Jaguaríndia, <strong>a retreat for those seeking to slow down</strong>. Here, time takes on a different rhythm, guided by the endless summer climate, the sound of the waves, and the sophistication that shapes every space. A place rich in new nuances of experiences and sensations.                </p>
                                <p class="font-sans font-light text-[#3a3a3a] [&_strong]:font-semibold [&_strong]:text-[#1a1a1a]" style="font-size:15px;line-height:var(--desc-leading,1.75rem);">
                    Created to preserve the natural beauty of its surroundings and honour the spirit of slow travel, the hotel blends seamlessly into the landscape through minimalist architecture, abundant natural elements, expansive gardens, diverse ethnic and cultural influences, and open spaces that inspire freedom.                </p>
                                <p class="font-sans font-light text-[#3a3a3a] [&_strong]:font-semibold [&_strong]:text-[#1a1a1a]" style="font-size:15px;line-height:var(--desc-leading,1.75rem);">
                    What we define as hospitality is, in fact, an invitation: <strong>privacy, authentic comfort, and a serene way of welcoming</strong>, where every detail exists to help you reconnect with what truly matters.                </p>
                                <p class="font-sans font-light text-[#3a3a3a] [&_strong]:font-semibold [&_strong]:text-[#1a1a1a]" style="font-size:15px;line-height:var(--desc-leading,1.75rem);">
                    Welcome to a place where beauty is simple, comfort is natural, and time finds its own flow.                </p>

                        <div class="flex flex-col gap-5">
                                <p class="font-sans font-light text-[16px] text-center text-[#3a3a3a] [&_strong]:font-semibold [&_strong]:text-[#1a1a1a]">
                    Jaguaríndia was conceived to offer a <strong>complete contemporary hospitality experience</strong>. The accommodations, filled with natural elements and a welcoming atmosphere, provide privacy and comfort in every detail.                </p>
                                <p class="font-sans font-light text-[16px] text-center text-[#3a3a3a] [&_strong]:font-semibold [&_strong]:text-[#1a1a1a]">

                                <p class="font-sans font-light text-[16px] text-center text-[#3a3a3a] [&_strong]:font-semibold [&_strong]:text-[#1a1a1a]">

Everything here has been designed so that your stay is experienced with <strong>tranquillity, pleasure, authenticity, and a connection to what truly matters</strong>.                </p>
